nl: 优惠券管理：查询有券名；表格展示券名、面额、有效期、状态（有效/过期）；支持新增、编辑、删除。后端列表接口只返回一个数组字段 list，没有总数字段，前端按本地分页处理。
nlEn: Coupon management: query by coupon name; the table shows coupon name, face value, validity period, and status (valid/expired); supports add, edit, and delete. The backend list endpoint returns only an array field list with no total field, so the frontend pages locally.
notes: AI-08: partial mapping — tableData only, no total (local paging) (vue3/schema)
